title: Small-Hom supported category carrying a given compact detector
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] in universe $u$ and $V\subseteq Y$ open. Let $E,Q\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y)$ [def-pc-derived-category] have cohomology stalks zero on $V$. Assume the ambient property of quasi-coherent cohomology and zero stalks on $V$ is triangulated [def-weil-triangulated-category], $E$ is compact [def-pc-compact-object] for universe-$u$ coproducts [lem-pc-derived-qcoh-direct-sums], and every supported $K$ is zero precisely when $\operatorname{Hom}(E[n],K)=0$ for all integers $n$. There exists a category $C$ with objects in universe $u+1$ and Hom sets in universe $u$, with a triangulated structure and universe-$u$ coproducts, and an additive exact functor $F:C\to D(\mathcal O_Y)$ preserving these coproducts, whose image has quasi-coherent cohomology. There exist $e,q\in C$ with $F(e)\cong E$, $F(q)\cong Q$, such that $e$ is compact and the singleton family $e$ generates $C$ [def-pc-generators]. No tower or telescope is asserted.

proof.text: Let P be the ambient property of quasi-coherent complexes with zero cohomology stalks on V. The supplied triangulated hypothesis equips its full subcategory with the inherited triangulated structure. E and Q lie in it by their supplied support properties.

source.place: Section Tag 0E4G, lemma-when-sheafy, proof of (3); derived.tex, lemma-write-as-colimit (Tag 09SN)

proof.text: Ambient coproducts have coproduct cohomology. Stalks of sheaf coproducts are direct sums of the input stalks, hence zero on V, including empty sums. The ambient quasi-coherent property is closed under these coproducts by schemeDerivedQCohClosedUnderCoproducts; the theorem on direct sums supplies the agreed coproduct structure in D_QCoh. Thus P is closed under universe-u coproducts and its inclusion creates them.

source.place: Section Tag 0E4G, lemma-when-sheafy, proof of (3); derived.tex, lemma-write-as-colimit (Tag 09SN)

proof.text: K-injective resolutions identify each derived Hom set with homotopy classes of chain maps into a K-injective representative. Chain maps between universe-u module sheaves form a universe-u-small set; quotients preserve smallness. Hence the supported category is locally u-small. The proved source-library instance DerivedCategory.locallySmall in WeilConjectures.CategoryTheory.GrothendieckAbelian.HasDerivedCategory supplies this conclusion after installing the module-sheaf Grothendieck structure and K-injective resolutions.

Take ShrinkHoms of this full subcategory, keeping its objects and shrinking Hom sets to universe u. Transport zero, addition, shifts and distinguished triangles along the canonical equivalence using triangulatedEquivalenceTransfer. Equivalences preserve coproducts. Compose the inverse equivalence with the inclusion to obtain F, additive and exact and preserving universe-u coproducts. Each image is quasi-coherent.

source.place: Section Tag 0E4G, lemma-when-sheafy, proof of (3); derived.tex, lemma-write-as-colimit (Tag 09SN)

proof.text: The supported objects E and Q give e and q. Full faithfulness and agreement of coproducts identify the compactness comparison with that for E: on every direct-sum summand both send f to f composed with its coprojection. Thus e is compact. The singleton coproduct is e. For any nonzero model object K, shifted-Hom detection gives a nonzero map E[n] to F(K). Applying the inverse shift equivalence rewrites it as a map E to F(K)[-n]. Full faithfulness and the shift comparison give a nonzero map e to K[-n], proving singleton generation.

lean.statement: theorem supported_compact_detector_model (Y : Scheme.{u}) [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))] (V : Y.Opens) (E Q : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y) (htri : ObjectProperty.IsTriangulated (fun K : schemeDerivedCategory Y ↦ schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y K ∧ ∀ (k : ℤ) (y : Y), y ∉ (V : Set Y)ᶜ → Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) k).obj K).val.presheaf y)))) (hcompact : letI : HasCoproducts.{u} (schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y) := derivedQCohDirectSums Y IsCompactObject E) (hsupport : ∀ (k : ℤ) (y : Y), y ∉ (V : Set Y)ᶜ → Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) k).obj E.obj).val.presheaf y))) (hgen : ∀ K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y, (∀ (k : ℤ) (y : Y), y ∉ (V : Set Y)ᶜ → Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) k).obj K.obj).val.presheaf y))) → (IsZero K.obj ↔ ∀ n : ℤ, Subsingleton (E.obj⟦n⟧ ⟶ K.obj))) (hQ : ∀ (k : ℤ) (y : Y), y ∉ (V : Set Y)ᶜ → Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) k).obj Q.obj).val.presheaf y))) : ∃ (C : Type (u + 1)) (_ : Category.{u} C) (_ : HasZeroObject C) (_ : HasShift C ℤ) (_ : Preadditive C) (_ : ∀ n : ℤ, (shiftFunctor C n).Additive) (_ : Pretriangulated C) (_ : IsTriangulated C) (_ : HasCoproducts.{u} C) (F : C ⥤ schemeDerivedCategory Y) (_ : F.CommShift ℤ), F.IsTriangulated ∧ F.Additive ∧ (∀ I : Type u, PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete I) F) ∧ (∀ K : C, schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y (F.obj K)) ∧ ∃ e q : C, Nonempty (F.obj e ≅ E.obj) ∧ Nonempty (F.obj q ≅ Q.obj) ∧ IsCompactObject e ∧ IsTriangulatedGeneratingFamily (fun _ : ULift.{u} Unit ↦ e)
